payload.title: M3b Optimizer item operations with validated citations
payload.description: After M3a's accuracy gate passes: the optimizer proposes add/change/retire per item, citing training item and note ids; citations not in the briefing window are rejected. Editor-written items may only receive candidate proposals an editor promotes. Record which items applied to each decision, honesty first. Per-item ablation on held-out labels on demand for clause measures. Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/Jg1DpixLFcAvnPy7d9RNDE
